boundary: Consumes the mechanics event graph but never changes biomechanical fault confirmation. Tactical intent may contextualize mechanics; it may not manufacture a mechanical diagnosis.

insight_families.allowed_claim: Describe recurring serve-plus-one direction and depth patterns.
Describe return landing-depth distributions by serve context.
Describe recurring rally direction and depth sequences.
Identify repeated short-ball contexts followed by approach or non-approach choices.

do_not_claim: shot intention from body pose alone
point construction when point boundaries are uncertain
ball depth from player location alone
tactical weakness from fewer than the configured point minimum
mechanical cause from a tactical correlation
activation_rule: Remain dormant until every required base capability is validated and versioned in the engine manifest.
